system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The on-device app filters this list per-provider — toggle individual tools in the **Tools** popover
system_prompt_style.note: SystemPromptService.swift exists and a system prompt editor ships in Settings; per-provider tool filtering implies runtime composition.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: It indexes entire codebases into a portable JSONL repo-map that any LLM can consume.
env_context_strategy.note: Agent reads codebase via file/search tools; optional project index is opt-in.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Tier 1 = on-device Apple Intelligence summarization (free, private, no API tokens). Tier 2 = aggressive prune if Apple AI unavailable.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Take screenshots or paste images. Vision-capable AI models analyze what they see

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: exposed to every LLM provider via `AgentTools.tools(for:)`

tool_count.evidence_quote: These are the canonical tool names defined in `AgentTools.Name.*` and exposed to every LLM provider
tool_count.note: Counting README tool tables: done, list_tools, search, chat, memory, plan, goal_state, restore_tool_result, directory, fetch, skill, ask_user, file, git, xcode, agent_script, user_shell, root_shell, shell, batch, multi, accessibility, applescript, javascript, safari, selenium, spawn_agent, tell_agent = 28 shipped; per-provider toggles reduce the default set, exact default unknown.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: `edit` = single-string replace. `diff_apply` = preferred for multi-line code edits

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MCP tools are appended at runtime as `mcp_<server>_<tool>`

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Agent! supports [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) servers for extended capabilities.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Built-in autonomous task loop that reasons, executes, and self-corrects. Agent! doesn't just run code; it observes the results, debugs errors, and iterates until the task is complete.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: **plan** | `create` / `update` / `read` / `list` / `delete` | Multi-plan CRUD with per-step status tracking

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Spawn isolated sub-agent. 3 concurrent (up to 6 read-only).
multi_agent_topology.note: Main agent may spawn workers via spawn_agent; default run is one agent.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: after some initial configuration and user approvals, it will do everything it can to carry out your wish
human_in_loop.note: ask_user mid-task dialog; approved-sender gating for iMessage; helper approval.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: **goal_state** | `set` / `get` / `mark` / `clear` | Persistent goal + success criteria; marking done requires evidence

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Recover the full text of a tool result truncated by compaction
state_persistence.note: SessionStore.swift and History (re-run previous prompt) exist; true resume of an interrupted run not explicitly documented.

self_verification.evidence_quote: an opt-in critic reviews the diff before completion
self_verification.note: CriticGate.swift; coding preference 'auto-verify' and visual tests are opt-in toggles.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Task Drain-Before-Start | Starting a new task awaits the previous task's full termination before beginning
retry_policy.note: Provider fallback chain retries the LLM call, not the task.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: **done** | `summary` | Signal task complete. Required at end of every task
termination_condition.note: Agent Options popover exposes 'max iterations'; StuckGuard.swift suggests stall detection but not documented.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Anthropic `cache_control` ephemeral + automatic prefix-cache hit tracking for OpenAI/Z.ai/Grok/Mistral/Gemini/Qwen/DeepSeek
cost_controls.note: Fallback Chain + per-agent model override = routing; LLM Usage cost tracking, token compression.

timeouts.evidence_quote: **ask_user** | `question` | Mid-task user dialog (waits up to 5 min)

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: **shell** | `command` | Fallback in-process shell (when Launch Agent is off)
execution_isolation.note: Default is user_shell via Launch Agent (host subprocess, no isolation); in-process AppleScript/JXA run inside the app. Closest value: subprocess-level host execution with no sandbox.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Shell as ROOT via Launch Daemon. Admin tasks only — no sudo
filesystem_access.note: Relative to host machine; root tier available.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Drives Safari hands-free -- search Google, click links, fill forms, read pages, extract information.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Hard-blocks catastrophic commands (`rm -rf /`, `rm -rf ~`, `dd` to `/dev/disk`, fork bombs, `--no-preserve-root`) before the Process is even constructed.
permission_model.note: Blocklist, coded as static_allowlist per rule; plus per-provider tool toggles.

tracing.evidence_quote: Agent! shows everything it does and logs every action.
tracing.note: AuditLog and activity log; no OTLP export found. Explicit: 'No telemetry.'

replayability.evidence_quote: Past prompts, errors, and task summaries for the active tab. Re-run a previous prompt with one click

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Toggle auto-verify, visual tests, auto-PR, auto-scaffold.
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark evaluation runner in the file tree; only unit tests.

guardrails.evidence_quote: if the LLM returns text claiming "I searched/opened/clicked" but made zero tool calls that turn, a correction is injected forcing it to use the real tool
guardrails.note: Shell Safety Service blocks commands (action_policies); outgoing iMessage replies stripped/capped.

target_domain.evidence_quote: An Autonomous Agentic Agent for Mac, and exclusive Apple only harnesss. Supports automation, scripting, coding, build anything and more.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Powered by 21 LLM providers across local and cloud platforms.
